Mod.Name: [Tsunamods] Card-RF
Mod.Author: Dulca & XHRIS & Hobbitdur & Ash & Slimebuck
Mod.Description: Card-RF improves Triple Triad with three card styles: Full artwork, Mix artwork/enhanced vanilla, and Enhanced vanilla. Choose gameplay card frames, three card backs, icons and boards independently of the card subjects.
